summary.text: Matt Duffield is serving his second term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 53, which includes Russellville and other portions of Pope County.

paragraphs.text: A graduate of Harding University, he had a 20-year career as a sports-entertainment promoter, producer and wrestler under the name "Matt Riviera", according to the House.
He is a member of the Kiwanis Club and the First Baptist Church of Pottsville, and hosts the annual Jock Davis Veterans Lunch honoring Russellville veterans.
